content.short: Verida is a multichain protocol for interoperable database storage and messaging built on decentralized identity.
content.description: Verida is a private data network for Web3 that lets users securely store their data. Developers can use Verida's personal data API to access off-chain information, including onboarding new users with their personal data from other centralized platforms. The platform also provides a simple, intuitive user interface for performing blockchain transactions. Verida offers token rewards for developers and end users, helping to drive participation and contribution.
